title: Early Ordering Allowance on Reissued Plan Invoices
content:
**Allowance rule.** A reissued plan invoice on a Real Estate Service Contracts order earns an early ordering allowance that follows the calendar days from the order date to the expected closing date on the order.

| Calendar days from the order date to the expected closing date | Early ordering allowance |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | $40.00 |
| 30 or more but fewer than 60 | $20.00 |
| fewer than 30 | no early ordering allowance |

The allowance is a flat amount subtracted once from the reissued plan premium; the reissued plan premium is never below zero.

## Boundaries (hypothetical order dated 1 March)

| Expected closing date on the order | Days | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| 30 March | 29 | none |
| 31 March | 30 | $20.00 |
| 29 April | 59 | $20.00 |
| 30 April | 60 | $40.00 |

The expected closing date read is the one shown on the order when the invoice is reissued.
